verdict.rationale: Exporting data is a fair question for a cap-table and equity-management SaaS, so the axis applies. The pack only shows inbound migration ('Migrate to Vestd'), data rooms for storing and sharing files, and an HRIS integration that brings data in. Nothing documents a full export of company data in open formats (CSV/JSON) or a path for leaving the platform, and no OpenAPI spec was found.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
